answer: Rule: a new identity boards only at a jetty guarded by three independent attestors, each locking 40 POA as a bridge bond. If the identity proves fake, all three bonds burn. One fake costs 120 POA; ten cost 1,200 POA plus thirty distinct attestors, since each vouches for at most five identities. The onyx seal cannot be forged without the attestor key, so fakes scale linearly in stake and quadratically in coordination.
